Beauty Influencers Nepal

Beauty Influencers in Nepal

Skincare routines, makeup tutorials, and honest product reviews drive real purchase decisions in Nepal's growing beauty market. Kolab connects cosmetic brands and salons with the creators shaping those decisions.

Why beauty content matters in Nepal's cosmetics market

Beauty and skincare brands in Nepal compete in a market where trust matters more than glossy advertising — a creator showing a genuine before-and-after or a real routine carries more weight than a studio ad.

Kolab connects cosmetic brands, skincare lines, and salons with beauty creators who post that kind of content regularly, so a product launch reaches an audience already primed to care.

What you get on Kolab

Discover by niche & location

Filter creator profiles by category and city to find beauty influencers who already make content close to your brief.

Set a budget and deliverables for a paid campaign, or offer a free open event in exchange for content and exposure.

What beauty creators cover on Kolab

Beauty creators on Kolab post skincare routines, makeup tutorials, product reviews, and salon or spa experiences across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, listed under the Beauty category alongside Fashion and Lifestyle.

Brands can post a paid review campaign, a product-seeding open event, or an ongoing ambassador-style partnership for a new line.

How it works

  • Create a business account on Kolab and post a paid campaign or a free open event.
  • Set your category, platform, budget or offer, and target beauty influencers anywhere in Nepal.
  • Browse creator profiles directly, or review the proposals creators submit to your campaign.
  • Message shortlisted creators in-app to align on the brief, deliverables, and timeline.
  • Approve the finished content and release payment through Kolab’s escrow-protected system.
  • Leave a review once the collaboration wraps up, building a track record for future campaigns.

Verified, safe collaborations

Beauty partnerships on Kolab run through the same identity verification and escrow-protected payments as every category, so product-seeding and paid review campaigns both have a clear, safe process.
